name: Dumbbells and a Bench
description: Three full-body workouts a week for 12 weeks with only a pair of adjustable dumbbells and an adjustable bench, at home or in a crowded gym. Squats, hinges, presses, rows and single-leg work in every phase; heavier from block to block, with a deload in week 9. When a weight becomes easy at the top of the rep range, move to the next dumbbell. Exercises marked optional add arms, shoulders, calves or abs for a longer day; leave them out when short of time.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.description: Three sets of ten to fifteen to learn the exercises

phases.name: Build
phases.description: Four sets on the main exercises, heavier

phases.name: Deload
phases.description: One lighter week: fewer sets and lighter weights, so you start the next phase recovered

phases.name: Strength
phases.description: Heavier sets of six to ten
